text: You premoved a recapture. Your opponent found an in-between check (Oct 19) The German masters named it a century ago: Zwischenzug (the in-between move). In 3-minute blitz, 80% of blunders come from assuming an automatic recapture. Before snatching a piece back, ask: Does my opponent have a forcing check first?
